title: Litenova Composition Recipe
description: One recipe in the composition catalog. The Markdown beside this file argues the shape; this file is what the validator resolves a page region against.

schemaVersion.$comment: Each release pins one exact shape. A consumer adopting a later release absorbs every difference at that moment, so no minor-compatible range exists between two releases. See CORE.AUTHORING.SNAPSHOT.003 and CORE.AUTHORING.SNAPSHOT.004.

scope.$comment: A page recipe is named by a page sidecar region. A shell recipe renders once around every page, so no page sidecar names it and the two-consumer rule counts frontends instead.

state.$comment: The same closed set ui-page.schema.json names, so a recipe cannot promise a page a state no sidecar can declare.
